narrative.overview: Scoped record of the built Agents roster and detail. Neutral operating rows lead with current work; detail puts situation and vitals before unified activity and configuration. Mail is primary; terminal debugging starts closed.

rules.name: Hue means state
rules.body: Neutrals carry the interface; subdued hue marks state or operator attention. State always includes words or a glyph.
